reasons: Status is correctly characterized as missing behaviour: §8.1 sets a three-year term and §9.1-9.3 provide only cause-based termination, with no Customer convenience right — a deviation under the rule's detection guidance for terms longer than 12 months.

The inserted clause reaches the preferred position on all three elements: Customer convenience termination on 30 days' written notice, refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (tied to §10.2), and an express statement that Vendor has no convenience/without-cause right during the term.

The conforming edit to §2.1 is necessary and narrowly targeted: it removes only the 'without reduction or termination rights' carve-out that would otherwise nullify the new exit right, leaving the take-or-pay volume commitment itself intact (changed-character ratio is high only because the clause is short).

Comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, states what changed and why, cites the playbook trigger, and offers the fallback (60-90 days' notice, fee capped at three months' Fees, no reciprocal Vendor right).

Drafting nit to correct before sending: the inserted paragraph carries no section number, yet the amended §2.1 cross-references 'Section 9.4' — label the new text as §9.4 (the slot is free between existing 9.3 and 9.5) so the cross-reference is not dangling.
